name: DisplaySelectFileDialogNode
label: Display Select File Dialog
description: Displays a file selection dialog to let users choose one or more files.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DialogTitle
fields.label: Dialog Title
fields.description: The title of the file selection dialog window.

fields.name: InitialFolder
fields.label: Initial Folder
fields.description: The folder path where the dialog starts. If empty, defaults to Desktop.

fields.name: FileFilter
fields.label: File Filter
fields.description: Filter for file types (e.g., "Text Files (*.txt)|*.txt"). Defaults to All Files.

fields.name: KeepFileDialogOnTop
fields.label: Keep Dialog On Top
fields.description: If true, keeps the dialog on top of all other windows.

fields.name: AllowMultipleSelection
fields.label: Allow Multiple Selection
fields.description: Allows user to select multiple files if set to true.

fields.name: CheckIfFileExists
fields.label: Check If File Exists
fields.description: Validates that the selected file(s) exist before returning.

fields.name: SelectedFiles
fields.label: Selected Files
fields.description: A collection of full paths for the selected files.

fields.name: ButtonPressed
fields.label: Button Pressed
fields.description: True if user clicked OK; False if Cancel was clicked or dialog closed.
